newsitem.title: GREECE: BANK OF GREECE DRAINS 100 BLN DRS AT 11.90 PCT.
newsitem.headline: BANK OF GREECE DRAINS 100 BLN DRS AT 11.90 PCT.

text.p: The Bank of Greece drained 100 billion drachmas of 14-day funds at 11.90 percent in today's fixed interest rate tender, it said.
"Individual bids were satisfied pro rata on the basis of the ensuing allotment ratio of 5.25 percent," it said.
A pact of 100 billion drachmas for 14-day funds expired today so that the system's liquidity is left unchanged. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
